script.title: setState called after dispose?

dialogue.speaker: jhaplu
dialogue.text: Mamu, weather screen se jaldi back dabaya toh app ne lal error phenka: setState called after dispose. Ye kya bawaal hai?

dialogue.speaker: paplu
dialogue.text: Re baba, tumhara API call abhi chal raha tha. Jawab aaya tab tak screen band ho chuki thi, phir bhi setState chal gaya.

broll.code:
final data = await api.fetch(city);
setState(() => weather = data);

dialogue.speaker: jhaplu
dialogue.text: Toh screen band hone ke baad setState rokne ka koi tareeka hai kya?

dialogue.speaker: paplu
dialogue.text: Haan, await ke baad mounted check karo. Screen chali gayi ho toh chupchaap ruk jao.

dialogue.speaker: jhaplu
dialogue.text: Aur agar main FutureBuilder use karun, toh kya yeh check phir bhi likhna padega?

pause.prompt: If the screen uses FutureBuilder instead of calling setState yourself, do you still need the mounted check?
choices: No, FutureBuilder stops rebuilding after dispose

dialogue.speaker: paplu
dialogue.text: Nahi. FutureBuilder khud dekh leta hai, widget hatne ke baad rebuild nahi karta. Bas future ko build ke andar mat banana.

script.takeaway: After an await, check mounted before calling setState; FutureBuilder handles this for you.

questions.prompt: Why did the app throw 'setState called after dispose'?
choices: The fetch finished after the screen was closed
questions.explanation: The await resumed after the State was disposed, and setState ran on a widget that no longer existed.
